summary: New large, well-circumscribed rounded density projecting over the right lower chest not seen on the prior study.

findings.pathology_other: Large rounded density, right lower hemithorax (possible distended stomach/bowel loop vs. pleural/pericardial fluid collection)
findings.rationale: A homogeneous, sharply marginated round opacity now overlies the right cardiophrenic region that was not present on the prior image; its very round, smooth contour is atypical for a simple pleural effusion meniscus, so a distended viscus cannot be excluded, and projection/rotation differences add uncertainty.
